name: F1 Scoreboard
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Formula 1 racing plugin showing driver/constructor standings with championship gap bars, race results, qualifying breakdowns, practice standings, sprint results, upcoming races, and race calendar. Features favorite driver/team spotlight cards, live session detection with auto-refresh, and team-colored displays.

versions.notes: Stop F1 taking over the Vegas marquee. get_vegas_content() contributed every prepared mode at once, which measured 114 cards / 14,592px on a 512px panel -- close to six minutes of unbroken F1 at 50px/s, because what this plugin's own rotation shows as eight separate screens the marquee splices into one block. A new "vegas": {"sections": [...]} setting picks what joins the marquee, defaulting to the next race and the last race's results (around 15 seconds). Every section remains available: add them back to get the old behaviour, or set an empty list to keep F1 out of the marquee entirely. The plugin's own display modes are unchanged and still show everything.

Fix ESPN 403s. Around 2026-08-04 ESPN's site.api began rejecting both browser-style and bare custom User-Agent strings, which returned 403 Forbidden for every request this plugin made. Requests now send an identifying agent with the project URL, which ESPN accepts. No behaviour change beyond the header.

Auto-heal the stale "timezone": "UTC" left in saved configs by the pre-1.x write-back bug: it is now detected and ignored when the global or system timezone disagrees, so users no longer see UTC times or have to hand-edit config.json. Etc/UTC remains the explicit opt-in for UTC.
Honor the global smooth-scrolling FPS target (target_fps/scroll_target_fps) in scroll mode.

Driver cards now show the full surname when the panel has room (standings, podium, favorite-driver spotlight, qualifying/practice/sprint rows), falling back to the 3-letter code only where space is tight. Fixed the race-calendar row so the session-type badge no longer overlaps the date or the right-aligned session time.

Fix event start times rendering in UTC. The plugin looked for the LEDMatrix global timezone only on cache_manager.config_manager; on cores that expose config_manager via the plugin manager instead, that lookup found nothing and every start time was drawn in UTC even though the clock plugin was correct on the same device. Timezone resolution now checks the plugin override, then both config managers, then the host system zone, before falling back to UTC. Adds a documented timezone setting under Advanced Settings -- previously the key was not in the config schema, so hand-editing it had no effect.

Readability fixes: bigger font on 256x64+ panels; constructor cards show full team names (drop to a smaller pixel font before shortening); fixed driver-split/last-race-points overlap on the constructor card.

Crisp per-size bitmap (BDF) fonts chosen by panel size; vertical-fill layout on tall panels (bigger logos, rows spread to fill height); larger circuit map on the upcoming card. Offline-deterministic golden tests added.

Size-adaptive renderer: one central layout-metrics pass; width-aware font sizing with pixel-grid snapping; measured stat zone / header reservations; logos scale with the panel; full team/country names on wide panels.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.
